text:
Noah (CS): FYI - MeridianCare returned the vendor questionnaire: main asks around embeddings export, deletion certificate, and EU residency. Can we align language for their renewal?
Priya (Security): Quick check: do we have a standard line for treating embeddings as customer data?
Evan (Eng): Yes. Short tech blurb: embeddings and derived indices are stored under the tenant namespace and by default remain in the tenant region. Export formats supported: ndjson, csv, protobuf.
Sam (Ops): Backups: encrypted snapshots retained 45 days by default; EU tenants get buckets in eu-west-1. Cross-region replication is off unless customer signs opt-in.
Noah (CS): They also want a deletion certificate example. Can Compliance produce a template cert?
Compliance Bot: Template available at #compliance-docs (internal) — file `deletion-certificate-template.pdf` created at 5106009000.
Priya (Security): Suggested DPA wording: "Derived artifacts (embeddings, indices, feature vectors) are treated as customer data and will be deleted according to the tenant deletion workflow below. We provide deletion certification on request"
Evan (Eng): Deletion workflow summary for reply: 1) mark tenant for deletion 2) remove API keys & live index 3) purge indices and metadata 4) erase snapshots per retention 5) issue deletion certificate. Typical completion: 48-72 hours for live purge, 60 days for backup expiration.
Sam (Ops): Note: forensic/legal holds can extend backup retention; we record exceptions and provide notice.
Noah (CS): Thanks — can we bundle this into a one-page answer for MeridianCare? They need it for procurement by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Security): I will draft the DPA paragraph and include the SOC2 scope line.
Evan (Eng): I'll add the export example and API curl snippet.
Sam (Ops): I'll confirm region bucket names and snapshot SLA by noon.
Noah (CS): Great — I'll assemble and send. Marking renewal-risk: medium-high until signed. :calendar:
